colors.name: Midnight Iris
colors.role: Primary text, headings, and dark section backgrounds - the deepest near-black with a violet undertone carries the same identity across both light copy and immersive dark bands

colors.name: Iris Spark
colors.role: Filled buttons, link emphasis, active states, gradient stops - the only vivid saturated color in the palette, used as a small functional spark against the cream canvas

colors.name: Violet Mist
colors.role: Soft accent washes, tag backgrounds, decorative highlights - a near-white violet tint that echoes Iris Spark at very low intensity

colors.name: Cyan Glow
colors.role: Supporting palette color for small decorative accents when the core palette needs contrast.

colors.name: Mint Whisper
colors.role: Pill badge and announcement tag backgrounds - a barely-there cool tint to differentiate informational chips from the warm cream canvas

colors.name: Iris Halo
colors.role: Soft highlight overlays and secondary gradient midtones - a lighter violet used in multi-stop gradients

colors.name: Fog
colors.role: Muted body copy, helper text, secondary labels - the primary low-emphasis text color against cream and white surfaces

colors.name: Shadow
colors.role: Stronger secondary text, metadata - deeper than Fog for labels that need more presence without reaching Midnight Iris

colors.name: Ash
colors.role: Disabled text, placeholder content, very low-emphasis UI elements

colors.name: Slate
colors.role: Supporting neutral for secondary UI, dividers, and muted labels. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

colors.name: Charcoal
colors.role: Secondary dark text, very dark UI elements

colors.name: Hairline
colors.role: Borders, dividers, card outlines - a cool light gray that separates surfaces on the warm cream canvas

colors.name: Silver
colors.role: Shadows, very subtle borders, disabled surface tones

colors.name: Snow
colors.role: Card surfaces, button text, dark-section text - pure white for maximum contrast on dark backgrounds

colors.name: Cloud
colors.role: Secondary surface, footer background - a cool off-white that sits one step below Snow

colors.name: Warm Paper
colors.role: Dominant page canvas - a warm beige that replaces the typical cold white SaaS background, giving the entire site a tactile, editorial feel

fonts.name: Plus Jakarta Sans
fonts.role: Single-family geometric humanist sans used for every text role from 10px badges to 58px display headlines

components.role: Primary action button - solid Iris Spark fill with white text

components.name: Dark Outline Button
components.role: Secondary action button - used for 'Book a demo' and similar

components.name: Text Link Button
components.role: Inline action with chevron - used in nav for 'Get Krisp' with dropdown indicator

components.name: Pill Tab Selector
components.role: Segmented control for switching between meeting states (During / After / Before Meeting)

components.name: Announcement Pill Badge
components.role: Eyebrow tag above hero headline - 'Introducing Accent Conversion' style

components.name: Gradient Display Headline
components.role: Signature hero text treatment - 'Voice AI' portion of the headline

components.name: Feature Card
components.role: Content card for feature grids - 'Multilingual meeting support', '1-click sharing'

components.name: Dark Feature Section Card
components.role: Feature card variant on dark Midnight Iris background

components.name: Customer Logo Strip
components.role: Social proof band showing client logos (Medium, Okta, Skechers, Autodesk, Sony, Cisco, ServiceTitan, GitHub)

components.name: Top Navigation Bar
components.role: Site header with logo, menu, and actions

components.name: Webby Award Sticker
components.role: Floating badge in bottom-right corner - '20th Annual Webby Awards, Vote for Krisp'

components.name: Icon
components.role: UI iconography for features and navigation

do: Use #f2ece2 (Warm Paper) as the default page canvas - never substitute pure white at the root level
Apply the Iris Spark to Cyan Glow gradient only on display-size headlines (42px+); never on body or heading text
Use 8px border-radius for all buttons and small interactive elements; 16px for cards; 9999px for pills and tabs
Double-duty #131032 (Midnight Iris) as both text color on light surfaces and background color on dark sections - the hue reads as the same brand identity in both contexts
Separate action button styles by fill: Iris Spark (#614efa) for one type, Slate (#1a1a22) for the other - never use two violet buttons side by side
Use Hairline (#e7e7ea) at 1px for card borders and dividers; achieve elevation through surface color shifts rather than shadows
Keep #918f9f (Fog) as the only muted body text color; never use Ash (#a1a1aa) for primary copy
doNot: Don't introduce new saturated colors - Iris Spark is the only vivid hue, and it should appear at most 1-2 times per viewport
Don't apply drop shadows to cards or panels - surface shifts on the Warm Paper canvas are the elevation system
Don't use pure #000000 for text - Midnight Iris (#131032) carries the brand undertone
Don't place white cards on white backgrounds; always layer Snow (#ffffff) on Warm Paper (#f2ece2) or Cloud (#f7f7f8) for separation
Don't use gradients on body, heading, or subheading text - the gradient treatment is reserved for display headlines only
Don't use border-radius larger than 8px on buttons - the 8px radius is the button signature, not pills
Don't show customer logos in full color - they must be muted to grayscale/gray to maintain the quiet editorial feel
